name: Gakkou Nanafushigi 4
source:
One day I got acquainted with a girl in the classroom. Beautiful black hair cover her shoulders, and face shines with bright expression. And above all, she calls me out...
Her name is Mika Saito, and her presence feels unnatural...

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/04/vn-of-month-february-2007-utsurigi.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
某一天，我在教室里结识了一位少女。她美丽的黑发披在肩头，脸上的神情明朗动人。更重要的是，她主动叫住了我……
她名叫Mika Saito，而她的存在，总让人觉得有些不自然……

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/04/vn-of-month-february-2007-utsurigi.html]vndbreview[/url]]
